summary: Completed full frontend testing of the VOID Tattoo Studio Spanish landing page across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All 13 functional requirements from the review request passed. No console errors, no page errors, no backend API failures observed. Booking form correctly opens WhatsApp wa.me URL via window.open after validation; Instagram links resolve to the correct URL.

issues:
Visually concatenated 'la' + 'tinta' (textContent reads 'El arte de latinta elevado' due to
). Renders fine visually but screen readers/SEO may read merged words. Consider adding non-breaking space or making 'la' end with explicit space before
.

critical_code_review_comments:
Hero.jsx: 'El arte de la
tinta' concatenates as 'latinta' in text content. Minor a11y/SEO concern; visually fine.

BookingForm.jsx: The 400ms setTimeout before window.open may be blocked as a popup in some browsers because it is no longer inside the user-gesture stack. Consider calling window.open synchronously inside the submit handler. (Worked in test because Playwright stubbed window.open, but real browsers may block.)
Stats.jsx counters use interval with 16ms step (~112 ticks for 1.8s). Works fine but requestAnimationFrame would be smoother.
Footer 'Términos' and 'Privacidad' links point to href='#' (placeholder). Acceptable since the brief says no real info, but worth flagging.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend was skipped per request. All sections render with correct data-testid attributes. Mobile hamburger opens drawer; X closes; mobile-nav link click scrolls to anchor. No console/page errors.
